items.mainDefect: In the admin-ui keycloak.v2 English bundle, error-invalid-multivalued-size was rewritten in Java MessageFormat syntax ({0}, {2,choice,...}), but the React admin console's i18next only fills in {{n}} placeholders, so users see the raw text.

secondary.defect: The same MessageFormat rewrite of error-invalid-multivalued-size was made in the account-ui keycloak.v3 English bundle, which also uses i18next, so the account console breaks the same way.
